detector_description: DeBERTa-v3-base with attack-aware Unicode preprocessing, 62-feature linguistic fusion (top-30 via MI), and targeted cell boosting. Proportional validation set, GDWL α=0.3. Trained on HC3 Plus + M4 + MAGE + RAID (3k/cell + cell boost).
training_data: HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE, RAID (v2.5 boosted)
